answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the ledge of a task receipt, and the canyon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the mesa of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, no identity may audit its own recruit.
